notes.title: Announcement on the Pause of the Third Magi Scapes Test
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hero-sama,[/b][/h2][p]Thank you so much for joining this test and helping us make the game better! As we mentioned earlier, this round of testing will be temporarily closed on [b]September 5th at 18:00 (UTC+8)[/b].[/p][p]During this period, we discovered many issues and also received a lot of valuable feedback from you. Moving forward, our development focus will be on:[/p][p][/p][h3]Compatibility Across More Systems[/h3][p]This test made us realize how important it is to optimize and support a wider range of hardware configurations. This will be our top priority in the next stage.[/p][p][/p][h3]Improved Lighting and Shadow Effects[/h3][p]Our current solution for lighting and shadows is still in its early stages. We will spend more time refining this system and experimenting with better approaches.[/p][p][/p][h3]AI Companion NPCs[/h3][p]We will work on unifying the generated NPC companions’ portraits, facial expressions, and character sprites with their generated backstories.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/2fb4b7e403b58179647e28e489ebe023728f8837.png"][/img]In addition, the way NPCs generate quests will be adjusted, with more interaction methods added.[/p][p][/p][h3]Narrative Experience Enhancements[/h3][p]Our goal is to bring you and your created characters into a vibrant, living world, where they feel truly alive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/39e29baf8d6480beffaef2e8dd9a09acc863e084.jpg"][/img][i](Can you guess who she is?)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]More Content[/h3][p]We noticed that some of you built incredibly beautiful camps during the test![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/eb90e9e17e80611d16fdb35cfaa03aed69865de3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/392f7a2b59fba4304ac6c0aba745e58886278a06.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/7edd932cbe7605e654c8ee1b5ddcc01e50a874aa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/f98fd269e40f47afc2aaafddd8c36f23596eb977.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/01e9a90192774a331d4277e3d87eaf2b8c86248d.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]That inspired us to add [b]more monsters, weapons, items, and objects[/b] to enrich the sandbox experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/c383a6a422b0575a955a50f1d8cdc77037fc1479.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i](Here’s a new desert plant we’ve been working on — the Baobab tree!)[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]How did you feel about this test?
The [b]“Magi Scapes Suggestion List”[/b] remains open — feel free to share your expectations and suggestions there anytime! See you soon![/p][p][b]— The [i]Magi Scapes[/i] Dev Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: MagiScapes Third Public Test Update Announcement – 2025.09.02
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear Adventurers![/b][/h2][p]Over the past few days of exploration, we’ve continued gathering your feedback and have rolled out another round of updates and optimizations. Below are the details of this update:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Content & Adjustments[/h3][p][b]New Area & Pathways[/b]
A brand-new underground passage has appeared, leading directly to the “Red Dragon’s” lair. We’ve also adjusted the Red Dragon’s location.
[i](Note: This change will only take effect in a newly created save file!)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/366d4e05760224055ae1f605c1dd0fe21c5226d1.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]AI Quest Generation System Upgrade[/b]
Thanks to improvements in our technical framework, other AI-NPCs in town are now also able to issue AI-generated quests! We hope you enjoy even more diverse adventures.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/c9bf291f5ad073d1d8a0ac361c94a03ed5ff4eba.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]System Optimizations[/h3][p][b]Quest Generation Logic[/b]
We’ve removed the special-case logic previously used for certain AI quests, making the system run more smoothly and efficiently.[/p][p][b]Unified Quest Triggering[/b]
From now on, all NPC-issued AI quests will unlock after you interact with them and increase your relationship level. The flow should feel more natural and coherent.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p][b]Data Error Fix[/b]
Resolved a data error that could occur during “Harvesting” interactions.[/p][p][b]Quest Interface Optimization[/b]
Fixed an issue where using the “Tab” key to open the quest interface could cause display or functionality errors.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for your continued support and feedback! We hope this update brings you a smoother and more enjoyable adventure. If you encounter issues not listed above, please feel free to join our community and share them with us![/p][p][b]— MagiScapes Dev Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Magi Scapes – 08.29 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2]Hello Hero-sama:[/h2][p]Here’s a summary of what we’ve fixed and improved in this update.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Quest System[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed dialogue issues in the Golden Thread and Ignacia quests[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a problem where submitting a quest could cause the game to freeze[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the way quest objectives are tracked and displayed[/p][/*][/list][h3]NPC Behavior[/h3][list][*][p]Raiders will no longer attack characters who are already down[/p][/*][*][p]Quests now progress correctly when teammates defeat monsters[/p][/*][*][p]Improved NPC movement and teleportation logic[/p][/*][/list][h3]Map & Interface[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed crashes that sometimes occurred when opening the minimap[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected icon errors on the minimap[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal responses when pressing certain UI buttons[/p][/*][/list][h3]Building System[/h3][list][*][p]Improved placement detection for items and structures[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crops shifting position after reaching maturity[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed severe lag caused by camp area calculations; movement no longer causes frame drops[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly improved item rendering and overall map performance[/p][/*][/list][h3]AI Character Generation[/h3][list][*][p]Added a cancel button to stop character generation at any time[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the generation process to reduce failure rates[/p][/*][/list][h3]Game Systems[/h3][list][*][p]The game now auto-saves at key moments[/p][/*][*][p]Added clear notifications when saving progress[/p][/*][*][p]Improved item stacking safety[/p][/*][*][p]Recipe adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Temporarily removed the White Ruins Floor recipe[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the mashed potato recipe and rebalanced its nutrition values[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]Improved ghost visuals for fallen NPCs, with different effects for recruitable NPCs and camp NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced overall lighting and visual quality[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs now move more smoothly through narrow passages[/p][/*][/list][h3]Player Experience[/h3][list][*][p]Improved the clarity of error messages[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the presentation of visual effects[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly reduced the likelihood of crashes[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again for all your feedback and support. We will continue working hard to bring you the best possible experience.[/p][p]If you encounter issues not listed here, please join our community and let us know.[/p][p]— Magi Scapes Develope Team[/p]

notes.title: Announcement & Q&A for Day 1 of the 3rd Open Test of MagiScapes — 2025.08.27
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, Hero-sama![/b] [/p][p]
After the public test demo of [i]Magi Scapes[/i] launched, we discovered a number of issues that may have affected your gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][p]First off, we sincerely apologize to everyone impacted. 🙏 [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/214a5d9d95befe0e324f486452b653f0ce1e16a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We didn’t anticipate some of these problems, and we’re truly sorry for the frustration they caused.
As you read this, we’re already working hard on fixes, adjustments, and optimizations. A patch will be released as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/2a1faf70d899eff9b96d5c6ad6da5fc5fa1494bc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p](Made in UE5 so it’s kinda poorly optimized… please accept my humble sacrifice, Epic🙇‍♂️)[/p][p][/p][h2]Here are the issues we’re aware of and how to handle them:[/h2][h3][b]Q: Why do AI-generated character portraits sometimes have white edges or mismatched expressions?[/b][/h3][p][b]A:[/b] Our character generation model is still being refined and polished. These issues will be gradually resolved in future updates![/p][p]Starting with the next version, all character expressions will be output with stable consistency.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/2fb4b7e403b58179647e28e489ebe023728f8837.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Q: My game crashed, and I lost progress / my camp disappeared / I can’t re-enter the game.[/b][/h3][p]
[b]A:[/b] We’ve identified the trigger for this issue and are working on a permanent fix.
In the meantime, we’re adding an [b]auto-save feature[/b] to minimize impact from crashes.
A patch is expected later today. Sorry again for the disruption! [/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Q: The game runs at very low FPS / screen flashes white / crashes due to performance issues.[/b][/h3][p]
[b]A:[/b] Even though [i]Magi Scapes[/i] is a pixel-art game, we’re building it in [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b] for enhanced visuals and AI compatibility.
Right now, the game isn’t well-optimized for lower-end PCs. We’ll continue to adjust and optimize performance to reduce hardware requirements in future updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/bd5ca95fbb17c3b31265d4464dbfc03b76484aa9.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Q: Generated items have various problems.[/b][/h3][p]
[b]A:[/b] Some AI-generated items are showing incorrect icons.
We’ve already tracked down the issue and are fixing it now.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Q: AI NPC creation progress stuck at 99%.[/b][/h3][p]
[b]A:[/b] This means you’re in the NPC generation queue due to high player activity. Please wait a few minutes.
If it takes longer than 15 minutes, contact us through the community for help.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Server Restart Notice[/b][/h3][p]To address some of these issues, we’ll be restarting the game servers on [b]August 28th at 05:00 (CST)/August 27th at 13:00(PST)[/b].
During this time, the game will be unavailable. Please make sure to save your progress in advance.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for your patience and understanding! We’ll keep pushing fixes as fast as we can, and your feedback is helping us improve every step of the way.[/p]

notes.title: Ready for the New Version of Magi Scapes? Public Test Starts on August 27th!
notes.content:
[p]Greeting, Hero-Sama! Morning, noon, or night—whenever you’re reading this, the land of [b]Oz[/b] is calling you back![/p][p]We’re kicking off a brand-new [b]public test[/b] on [b]August 27th at 05:00(UTC+0)/August 26th at 22:00(Pacific Time)[/b]!  [/p][p]The test will run for [b]two whole weeks[/b], so grab your gear (and your curiosity) and come hang out in the game again~[/p][p]It’s been half a year since the last test, and we’ve been [i]super busy[/i] during that time. Tons of optimizations, bug fixes, polish, and yes… some highly requested features are finally here.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The highlight this time? Your AI partners[/b] [b]just got way smarter![/b] They’ll listen more closely, adventure more naturally, and even let you know what they need from [i]you[/i]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/fbfaa04e86498917bdc5c35ba7d1f803b4c30345.png"][/img][/p][p]Oh, and did we mention… Oz is now a [b]real continent[/b]![/p][p]

notes.title: Magi Scape debuts at Gamescom, showcasing the possibilities of AI & Games!
notes.content:
[p]Hey, Hero-san, long time no see~
These past few days, we brought [i][b]Magi Scape[/b][/i] to Cologne, Germany, and for the very first time, we’re meeting players from all around the world face-to-face at Gamescom! 
To celebrate, we’ve prepared a brand-new version for offline demo play—come visit us at [b]Hall 3.2 F049[/b] and give it a try!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/8782ed93dbfaafc55f6b2637a1968afe1875fa34.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Compared to the previous version, the biggest update is the addition of a [b]seamlessly connected world map of the land of Oz[/b]~ 

At the same time, we’ve prepared plenty of special gifts for heroes who try the demo at our booth.  [/p][p]For friends who can’t make it, don’t worry—click the link below to join our Discord, where we’ll soon be launching an [b]open test[/b]. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/a4e046965daa8ab2a636a6f391d766ad7da2a0b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For a small team like ours, being able to bring our game overseas and receive feedback from players across different cultures is truly magical. Of course, none of this would have been possible without your continuous support.[/p][p]We hope more and more players will fall in love with [i][b]Magi Scape[/b][/i], and help us make it softer, warmer, and full of life.
If you also want to live in the world with AI companions, don’t forget to add [i][b]Magi Scape[/b][/i] to your wishlist!
With your support, we’ll have the courage to keep moving forward.


[b]AUTOGAME[/b][/p]

notes.title: Announcement on the End of the Second Magi Scapes Test (We'll Meet Again Soon!)
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Players,[/h3]

We sincerely appreciate your continued attention and support for *Magi Scapes*! Since the launch of the second round of technical testing, we have kept a low profile without large-scale publicity. However, to our delight, a significant number of passionate players have actively participated, providing nearly a thousand valuable suggestions and feedback through forums, communities, and surveys. Your genuine support has deeply encouraged us and strengthened our resolve to refine the game's quality with dedication!

Based on the comprehensive collection of test data and our version iteration plans, we have decided that the trial version for the second round of technical testing will officially go offline at 23:59 (Beijing Time) on March 18, 2025. After this, our development team will fully focus on the following:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/dc0025d8b0a86dd41b1717b963e29687524e6fd0.gif[/img]

[h2]Expansive Map Generation System[/h2]

Creating a more open and free world where every adventure is filled with unexpected surprises.

[h2]Further Integration of AI Models with NPC Companions[/h2]

Enhancing NPC companions with more distinct personalities and growth trajectories, incorporating the latest AI-driven behavior planning and content generation mechanisms.

[h2]Ongoing Upgrades to Combat Experience and Content[/h2]

Further improving the core combat feel and expanding the variety of monsters, weapons, and other content.

[h2]Multiplayer Functionality Framework Development[/h2]

Designing a multiplayer cooperation framework to support multiple players exploring *Magi Scapes* together.

[h2]Expansion of Gameplay Progression[/h2]

Extending the game’s progression to provide a richer content experience for players.

Due to the complexity of developing these features, the start date for the next round of trials will be announced based on our development progress. In the meantime, we will share the latest updates from time to time through our official communities (Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Discord, and Xianhei Box, among others), so stay tuned!

Once again, we extend our heartfelt thanks to every player who has participated in testing! Your passion and insights are what drive *Magi Scapes* to evolve continuously. Rest assured that all the waiting will ultimately transform into an even more breathtaking adventure—one to embark on with the people you wish to journey with!

[h3]*Magi Scapes* Development Team  
March 18, 2025[/h3]

notes.title: Announcement on the End of the First Magi Scapes Test (We'll Meet Again Soon!)
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support and love for Magi Scapes! Since its announcement on September 30, 2024, in just over a month, Magi Scapes has garnered nearly [b]5,000 [/b] wishlists—a fantastic achievement! We've received sincere praise and feedback from players on platforms like Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and Black Box, which has made us incredibly excited and motivated to continue improving and enriching Magi Scapes.

In the coming period, we will keep iterating on content, focusing on developing the [b]"AI Town" feature[/b], [b]refining combat mechanics[/b], and [b]expanding the game's scope[/b] to provide players with a more immersive experience.

Due to the manpower required for version iteration and server operation costs, the current trial version will be temporarily taken offline at [u]15:59 (UTC) on November 14, 2024[/u], ending our first round of public testing. We aim to iterate on content as quickly as possible, with plans to launch the next round of public testing at [u]the end of 2024 or early 2025[/u]. Please stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214628/bf228481cd5b434625c40c5d9879824159036bc5.png[/img]
